title: 第5章 大闹婚宴
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

穿越倒计时：6天。

谭筝迈着六亲不认的步伐，走进了御景世纪酒店。

鎏光宴会厅门口立着新人的婚纱照，她停下脚步再确认了一遍，就是这没错。

只不过王大丫改名了，现在叫王莉莉。

改了名字整了容，要不是眉眼间还有些曾经的影子，再加上朋友的通风报信，她还真认不出来。

谭筝来的时候，宴会厅外已经架起了桌子，开始收份子钱了。

她顺着人群排队，很快就轮到了。

负责登记的老人家，抬头瞥了一眼谭筝，问：“是女方的朋友吧？”

“是。”谭筝点头。

“你叫啥名？随多少？”

“谭筝，言西早谭，风筝的筝，随三百。”

三百？有点少啊……老人家心里嘀咕了一句，但面上不显，刷刷两下就登记好了。

只是他伸手后，却迟迟不见谭筝把钱递来。

“姑娘，你礼金呢？”

“新娘子还欠我钱呢，等我把钱讨到了，再回来补上。”

“啊？”

听到这话，周边立马热闹起来，大婚之日讨债，这摆明了就是来砸场子的啊！

谭筝不管其他人好奇的目光，大摇大摆地走进了宴会厅。

瞧得出这场婚宴的预算不低，偌大的宴会厅，除了中间的舞台，其余地方都被酒桌给占满了，粗略一看，至少有个几十桌。

谭筝随便找了个位置坐了下来，拿起桌面上的菜单一看，东星斑、澳龙、帝王蟹……海鲜一大堆，菜也挺硬。

这么一瞧，她刚刚随的三百貌似不太够。

不过没事，这顿饭，就算她白吃，也没人敢多说什么。

谁叫她占理。

谭筝刚吃上几粒花生，就有人坐到她身边，好奇打听。

“诶，妹子，那新娘子欠你多少钱啊？把你气得在人家结婚的日子上门讨。”

Page (1/3)

Countdown to time travel: 6 days.

Tan Zheng walked into Yujing Century Hotel as if she didn't recognize her relatives.

There was a wedding photo of the couple standing at the door of the gilded banquet hall. She stopped and confirmed again that it was correct.

But Wang Daya changed her name and is now called Wang Lili.

She had changed her name and had plastic surgery, but if it weren't for the traces of her past between her eyebrows and her friends' tips, she wouldn't have been able to recognize him.

When Tan Zheng arrived, tables had been set up outside the banquet hall and everyone started collecting money.

She lined up along the crowd and soon it was her turn.

The old man in charge of registration glanced up at Tan Zheng and asked, "Is he a friend of the woman?"

"Yes." Tan Zheng nodded.

"What's your name? How much do you want?"

"Tan Zheng, Yan Xi Zao Tan, kite's kite, follow three hundred."

Three hundred?It's a bit small... The old man muttered in his heart, but he didn't show it on his face. He just swiped twice and registered.

But after he stretched out his hand, Tan Zheng didn't hand over the money for a long time.

"Girl, where is your gift?"

"The bride still owes me money. When I get the money, I will come back to make up for it."

"Huh?"

After hearing this, the surrounding area immediately became lively. They were collecting debts on their wedding day. It was obvious that they were here to cause trouble!

Tan Zheng walked into the banquet hall regardless of the curious looks of others.

It can be seen that the budget of this wedding banquet is not low. Except for the stage in the middle of the huge banquet hall, the rest of the room is occupied by wine tables. At a glance, there are at least dozens of tables.

Tan Zheng found a seat and sat down. He picked up the menu on the table and took a look. Eastern star spot, Australian dragon, king crab... there were a lot of seafood, and the dishes were quite tough.

Looking at it this way, the three hundred she just took with her didn't seem to be enough.

But it's okay. Even if she eats this meal for free, no one dares to say anything.

Who told her to be reasonable?

As soon as Tan Zheng ate a few peanuts, someone sat next to her and asked curious questions.

"Hey, sister, how much does the bride owe you? You're so angry that you came to ask for it on her wedding day."
